allow: PowerShell(Get-Printer | Select-Object Name, DriverName, PortName, PrinterStatus | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Host "--- USB devices ---"; Get-PnpDevice -Class USB -Status OK | Select-Object FriendlyName, Status | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Host "--- All PnP printer-ish devices ---"; Get-PnpDevice | Where-Object { $_.FriendlyName -match 'print|thermal|POS|BT' } | Select-Object FriendlyName, Class, Status | Format-Table -AutoSize)
PowerShell(Get-PnpDevice | Where-Object { $_.FriendlyName -match 'Bluetooth' -or $_.Class -eq 'Ports' } | Select-Object FriendlyName, Class, Status, InstanceId | Format-Table -AutoSize -Wrap)
